# Frontend Core Next.js Full Guide

Use this guide for detailed Next.js App Router implementation strategy.

## Scope

- Route and layout architecture
- Server/client boundaries
- Server actions and route handlers
- Metadata and cache behavior

## Core Playbook

1. Define route ownership and rendering model.
2. Keep data mutations in server actions.
3. Validate caching and revalidation semantics.
4. Test route behavior and hydration outcomes.
